common_supported_claims: Neural weight manipulation (generation, adaptation, merging) can produce functional behavior across multiple families
Execution feedback and traces improve system performance (F3 program synthesis, F2 hypernetworks)
Formal specification enables verification (F7 types/contracts, F8 computational effects at theoretical level)
Low-rank and parameter-efficient methods are effective for adaptation (F5 LoRA, F6 model merging)
Dynamic weight generation is a cross-cutting theme (F1 weight programs, F2 hypernetworks, F5 adapters)
cross_family_conflicts: F1 (weights as programs) vs F7 (types as specs): fundamentally different specification paradigms — implicit (weight space) vs explicit (type system)
F3 (neural synthesis) vs F7 (formal verification): neural approaches lack formal guarantees that refinement types provide
F6 (model merging) vs F8 (effect handlers): merging operates in weight space without semantic theory, while effect handlers have rigorous category-theoretic foundation but no implementation
analogy_only_connections: F4 (neural operators) and F8 (effect handlers): both learn/define operators, but neural operators are empirical while effect handlers are categorical
F5 (LoRA) and F7 (refinement types): both add structure to base models, but LoRA adds parameters while refinement types add specifications
F10 (agent tools) and F3 (program synthesis): both generate functional artifacts, but agent tools are practical while program synthesis is formal
evidence_gaps: No source provides execution trace + formal verification simultaneously
No source addresses versioning of generated artifacts (GAP-019 universally unsupported)
No source provides empirical validation of Function OS nodes — all evidence is by analogy or partial support
F9 (probabilistic) and F10 (agent) have the most sources but least formal rigor
F7 (types) and F8 (effects) have the strongest formal foundations but no implementation
identity_chain_risks: Systematic source identity issues across 121CX prior cards (S120-001~010): 4 unknown identity status
Cross-model acceptance reveals identity errors not caught by original reviewer

N1_FunctionSpec.candidate_impact: Specification language for Function OS — refinement types provide formal, decidable specification

N2_Representation.strongest_evidence: F1 (weight space representation), F6 (weight space operations)
N2_Representation.candidate_impact: Multiple representation paradigms: weight space, Fourier space, type systems — no unified representation proven

N3_Compiler.strongest_evidence: F7 (Flux as verification compiler), F4 (operator learning as compilation)
N3_Compiler.candidate_impact: Compilation mechanisms vary by family — no universal compiler architecture

N4_Artifact.strongest_evidence: F6 (model versions as artifacts), F3 (synthesized programs as artifacts)
N4_Artifact.candidate_impact: Weak evidence — no registry, versioning, or composition mechanism for artifacts

N5_Interpreter.strongest_evidence: F8 (handlers as homomorphisms — STRONGEST mathematical foundation)
also_supported_by: F7 (algorithmic type checking with ghost parameter synthesis)
N5_Interpreter.candidate_impact: Interpretation models range from category-theoretic (F8) to algorithmic (F7) to empirical (F3)

N6_ExecutionTrace.strongest_evidence: F3 (execution traces central to program synthesis)
also_supported_by: F8 (computation tree in free model as structured trace)
N6_ExecutionTrace.candidate_impact: Execution trace evidence is strongest in program synthesis and algebraic effects; absent in weight-program families

N7_Validator.strongest_evidence: F7 (SMT-decidable formal verification — STRONGEST in batch)
N7_Validator.candidate_impact: Formal validation via SMT solving is the strongest validation mechanism; other families lack formal verification

N8_ComposerRouter.candidate_impact: Composition mechanisms: weight arithmetic (F6), adapter routing (F5), theory combination (F8) — no unified framework

N9_VersionedRegistry.candidate_impact: No evidence for versioned registry across any family — this is the largest evidence gap

prohibited_final_rulings: No GAP adjudication performed — all impacts are candidate only
No Function OS node freezing performed — all impacts are candidate only
